spec_match.rationale: Stores the last failure in IndexedDB (structured serialization) and reads it back after a reload as the diagnostics panel would.

interactive.rationale: Record/reread/reload/clear controls with a live readout; reload simulates a restart.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card describes exactly what the page does, including its labelled fallback.

edge_cases.rationale: DataCloneError from put() caught and stored as a labelled plain record; buttons gated until the DB opens; a decoded value that lost its type is flagged UNEXPECTED.

references.rationale: See-also links chromestatus.com/feature/5158277221580800 plus the spec section.

conformance.rationale: Backs the manual decode-survives-writer-kill-switch assertion, which needs two launches of a 159 build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp not available in this environment): every control exercised at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, default and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features --enable-blink-features=WebTransportErrorSerialization (identical results), 0 console errors, 0 failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow, screenshots read. 153 lacks the change, so only the honest fallback branch ran natively; success-branch rendering was exercised with a test-only constructor shim (not shipped), and the real 159 success path is unverified.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert records the primary contract and the fallback branch separately, so pre-alignment browsers do not raise false failures.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; buttons set background and color together; status colours emerald-dark/rose on ivory.

accessibility.rationale: Disabled buttons reference the role=status DB state via aria-describedby; polite atomic readout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: 0px overflow, all buttons/inputs >=44px, single-column stacking on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Verify the success path on a Chromium 159 build
openQuestions.detail: Only Chrome 153 was available; it lacks the standard constructor and serialization (no flag enables them). Re-run every control on a 159+ build (and once with --disable-blink-features=WebTransportErrorSerialization) and confirm the success branches report intact WebTransportError values.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the kill-switch decode path
openQuestions.detail: On 159: record a failure, relaunch with --disable-blink-features=WebTransportErrorSerialization, reload: the stored record must still decode as a WebTransportError while a new write falls back.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for async results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use one polite live region per result area; announce discrete outcomes, not interstitial states; use native semantics.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Result panels are aria-live=polite aria-atomic; page-level support verdicts are role=status; native buttons/inputs/selects with visible focus outlines.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid with minmax(0,1fr) tracks and min-width:0 children; wrap long tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Shared wte-demo.css uses minmax(0,1fr) grids, min-width:0 and overflow-wrap on code/readouts; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Store only what the feature needs.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Only the error message/source/code and a timestamp are stored, under one key, with a Clear control.

summary: Interactive, honest-fallback demo; verified only on Chrome 153 (pre-alignment), so the 159 success path remains to be browser-verified.
